heading: This Afternoon
text: Mostly to partly cloudy. Highs from the mid 60s to lower 70s. Light and variable winds east of the Greens, becoming south 5 to 10 mph in areas west of the Greens.

heading: Tonight
text: Variable clouds. Lows from the upper 40s to mid 50s east of the Greens, mid 50s to lower 60s west. Winds remaining light and variable east of the Greens, becoming south 5 to 10 mph in areas west of the Greens, and gusting to 15 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: Variable clouds. Chance of an afternoon shower, mainly in New York, and father east into the central and southern Greens. Highs from the upper 60s to mid 70s. Winds becoming south to southwest 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys.
